g.text: FlareRank4Convo2 begins.
I've been thinking about your problem, and I think I have an idea on how to get rid of Lizzie permanently.
All right. Let's work on negotiating some kind of peace, here...
Flare, are you there?
I need to talk to Lizzie.
I need to talk to Lizzie.
We need to talk.
I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...
Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?
I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...
Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?
yeah?
when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....
when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....
Check boolean FlareWar4
but You speak to Us of ridding the world of Us
what do You need from Us, Sweet One?
I think we take her to the Void. Make the Indifference deal with her.
true
I think we find a way to kill Lizzie. I've killed thousands of Infested before. One more can't be hard.
true
Check boolean FlareWar4b
false
WHY
Flare is worried that once they let you in, you're going to consume their consciousness. They'll cease to be "them."
Can you describe to me how you're going to change them, exactly, if you get what you want? In... normal, non-cosmic horror terms, I mean.
...What could possibly go wrong...
I know you scoffed at the idea before, but I have *very* unique ways of killing things.
true
false
false
I've thought about your idea of trapping her in Duviri and... I think you're right. I think it'll work.
true
false
WHY should we heed YOUR words when YOU seek to drive US away?!
what is so special about being Them?
Update boolean FlareNonCosmic
i'm willing to give anything a t
Shove her into the prison cells with Kullervo. She can keep him company.
Calm down! I was just trying to get Flare out of the way. I want to talk about negotiating some kind of peace between you two.
Because you're wrong, and they want you out of their life. So I'm going to find a way to kill you, throw you into the Void - or something. I don't care what.
They are an empty husk, a shell of a porcelain painted doll without Us
We will do Our best... ;)
mmmmh.... dubious methods, but We are listening... go on
I am very, *very* good at killing the unkillable. Trust me.
We seek to fill Them up with Song. With Greatness. With that which They have sought Their entire lives
They chase the stars, and we consume Them
hhaaAHAHHAHHAHAHHAHA
and in joining with us, They will know what it is to be That which They Seek
silly, foolish... little Demooon....
Check boolean FlareNonCosmic
did You thiiink... it would honestly be... So Simple...?
I'm starting to see why Flare thinks you're going to eat them, Lizzie.
true
false
Is that your best take on "non-cosmic horror" terms?
true
So... you *do* plan to consume their consciousness?
false
mmmhmmmmmmhehehehe....
....sorry
y...es?
We are going to let You into a... little secret...
We. Plan. To. Share? Their? Mind?
We will try again. Ahem.
We are not... the first Lizzie...
Is that. Better?
the first is at the bottom of the river...
We are not very good at being Small
the second, a charred and empty husk
it is why We have not spoken to this Demon very often
the third, rejected, bones broken like a baby bird thrown from the nest like a neglectful mother
I don't think "sharing" is going to be good enough for Flare.
When you say "share" though, do you mean... "share" like you tried to "share" Eleanor?
try... try... try...
but... isn't it fair...?
Yes! Precisely like that. She is such a Lovely One. We Love Her, So Very Much...
run... run... run...
I don't think Flare will ever want to give up their personal identity, Lizzie. But I also don't see the value in trying to kill or destroy you.
You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.
Why couldn't We have been Born to Her...
We... are ever-present... what would You be... without Us, TENNO...?
but we are Their friend, not Their enemy...
She would have Embraced Us...
kill us all You like for it is You who breeds us, Demon...
Then back off on the whole "consuming their consciousness" thing.
You've been doing a shit job at showing them that.
What's "sharing" to you, looks like "destruction" to us. You have to try to understand that. I know it's hard to "be small" but try. Remember what happened to Eleanor? And Lettie?
You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.
oh... and before You go...?
We will... think...
We saw it a million times over, and then a half a million again in salvation...
but We are Their friend, not Their enemy...
next time You slide inside of one of Us, one of our hollowed dolls...
Update boolean FlarePeace5
and again, and again, and again...
Then back off on the whole "consuming their consciousness" thing.
You've been doing a terrible job of showing them that.
next time We feel You delve into our depths, slipping into our Heat, our Warmth, our Embrace...
+20 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
We will... think...
think to Yourself...
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank4Convo3.
This Demon speaks sense...
Update boolean FlarePeace5
is it just a little tighter than before...?
We will... consider Their words...
+20 Chemistry
Update boolean FlareLizzieEnemy
Update boolean FlarePeace6
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank4Convo3.
Check boolean FlareJumpScare
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
true
